layout.hierarchy: Title largest and boldest (red/blue mix); the two plots dominate the slide area equally; red captions medium-bold beneath plots; small annotation 'K=5, cyan class' inside right plot; tiny slide number badge top-right.

visual_elements.description: Left scatter plot: a single red query point near center-right of the panel. Around it: a cluster of ~8 bright green points to the lower-left, a cluster of ~7 cyan points to the right, a cluster of ~5 beige/tan points below. Thin light-gray lines radiate from the red query point to all other points. The 5 nearest neighbors are highlighted with magenta/purple dashed circles: these include cyan points and one green point closest to the query. Red axis arrows: vertical arrow pointing up on the left edge, horizontal arrow pointing right along the bottom. No axis ticks or numeric labels.

Right scatter plot: points from the left plot re-plotted sorted by distance to the query along the x-axis. ~30 small red dots sit on the horizontal axis (one per data point). Above them, colored points (green, cyan, beige) rise in an increasing curve from lower-left to upper-right, each connected to its red axis dot by a thin dotted vertical line. A solid vertical blue line is drawn just after the 5th point from the left, separating the 5 nearest neighbors (left of line) from the rest. Text annotation at top-left of panel: 'K=5, cyan class' with the word 'cyan' highlighted on a cyan background. Red axis arrows: vertical up on left, horizontal right at bottom. No numeric ticks.
Yellow circle badge containing black number '49' (slide number)

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold, with 'K-Nearest Neighbors' in dark red and '(KNN) , K=5' in blue. Captions under plots are bold red, smaller than title. In-plot annotation 'K=5, cyan class' is small black text with 'cyan' highlighted in cyan. Slide number in small black text inside yellow circle.
animation_state: Fully built; both panels and all annotations visible. A mouse cursor arrow is visible in the right panel near the lower-left points, suggesting a live lecture capture.

Add a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with black '49' at the top-right corner. 4. Left panel: draw red axis arrows (up arrow on left, right arrow on bottom). Scatter ~20 points: one red query point near center, ~8 green (#7CFC00) points lower-left, ~7 cyan (#00FFFF) points right, ~5 beige (#F5DEB3) points below. Draw thin light-gray lines from the red point to every other point. Draw magenta (#FF00FF) dashed circles around the 5 points nearest the red point. 5. Below left panel, add bold red caption 'Select Nearest 5 Neighbors'. 6. Right panel: draw red axis arrows. Place ~30 small red dots evenly along the x-axis. Above them, plot the colored points (green, cyan, beige) in increasing height left-to-right forming a rising curve; connect each colored point to its red axis dot with a thin dotted vertical line. Draw a solid vertical blue (#0000CC) line just right of the 5th point. 7. Add small black text at top-left of right panel: 'K=5, cyan class' with 'cyan' on a cyan highlight. 8. Below right panel, add bold red caption 'Vote on 5 Nearest Neighbors'.
